correctness.rationale: Fourth-order Fourier zero-sum analysis shows the only nonpairing relation for two positive distinct frequencies is 3m=n, giving the exact fourth moment and a one-variable amplitude-phase optimization. The cubic G(r)=3r³−3r²−3r+1 has its relevant root in (1/4,3/10); the exact positive stability factor was independently confirmed by symbolic rational-polynomial algebra in this run. Inspected RESULT.md and checker.py; finite enumeration is corroboration, not the all-frequency proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Strong prior result mathematically dominates the submitted claim or its central theorem. The prior published three-consecutive-harmonic theorem optimizes the *larger* real space span{cos t,sin t,cos2t,sin2t,cos3t,sin3t}, and proves its sharp lower fourth-moment 1.220691895037155, exactly the same cubic root r and equality family with the second harmonic zero. Hence the identical sharp bound and extremizers for the 1:3 two-tone space are already a direct special case; dilation t↦mt gives all m:3m. The other frequency ratios have no fourth-order unpaired zero-sum, so their 3/2 bound is an elementary orthogonality count. The later explicit quadratic deficit is direct factorization of the same prior one-variable objective. It supplies no substantive non-implied scientific remainder.
